messages.author: e2060275ccaa853c
messages.subject: Participating in GSoC 2011
parts:
Hi all,

I am Pivithuru Wijegunawardana a final year Computer science and
Engineering undergraduate student of University of Moratuwa Sri Lanka.
I am looking forward to participate in GSoC 2011 with R as mentoring
organisation. I looked in to R project ideas for GSoC 2011 and there
are many interesting ideas that I would like to work on.

I have experience in working with R, and using R functionalities in
java via JRI. I am very much interested in project idea image
analysis for R [1], since I have a sound Java background as well as
image processing. I looked into ImageJ GUI and tried to get an
understanding about the project. But in this project idea page there
are no tests mentioned for this like other project ideas. It will be
really helpful for me to start working on that kind of test earlier on
if you can publish any tests regarding that project if there is going
to be any.

Your suggestions and ideas regarding the project will be really
helpful and looking forward to work with R in this summer.

[1]-http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?
id=developers:projects:gsoc2011:image_analysis

Thank you
--
Best regards,
Pivithuru Wijegunawardana
Department of Computer Science and Engineering
University of Moratuwa
Sri Lanka

I'm glad to hear you are interested. I've fleshed out the project page
a little bit, and added some exercises for you. I would encourage you
to poke around in the source code of ImageJ, JGR and Deducer. Also
play around with EBImage. If you have any questions, feel free to
contact me.


Best,
Ian
